title: MatchResult
description: Evaluation schema for patient-to-trial eligibility matching with criterion-level explainability

match_status.description: ELIGIBLE = all mandatory criteria satisfied; INELIGIBLE = at least 1 mandatory criterion violated; POTENTIALLY_ELIGIBLE_PENDING_INFO = no violations, but 1 or more criteria have missing data

is_eligible.description: True only if match_status is ELIGIBLE

has_insufficient_info.description: True if missing patient data prevented definitive determination of one or more criteria

match_score.description: Score between 0 and 100 representing eligibility degree. STRICT RULE: Must be 0 for INELIGIBLE to prevent rank override

clinical_rationale.description: Summary medical explanation of the match outcome

status.description: SATISFIED: rule met; VIOLATED: rule failed/exclusion triggered; UNKNOWN: patient data missing

reason.description: Detailed human-readable explanation of why this criterion passed, failed, or is missing
